reviews.title: Fans are great.
reviews.comment: The fans are great. They are aesthetically pleasing and working well. The daisy chain feature is great and makes it easy to install. However the controller that came with it has two bad ports. After contacting support, they sent over a replacement and all is working well.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.title: Lian Li FTW!!
reviews.comment: What can I say, I went almost all out in this build and since it was a damn near all white build, that led me to these fans. My temps are cool and my components are happy. Not to mention when configured correctly, will give you a pleasing look like in my pictures (personal opinion of course :P) All fans in the pictures are a mix between the reverse version and regular version I must add. I bought these for the controller to wire a total of 13 fans together. 2 are in the side of the case and not visible.
reviews.author: Hi Riskey_Dimplez

reviews.title: Pefect fit
reviews.comment: This case fan is great, does a great job at cooling and not noisy at all.  Love the controls over lighting options.  Will definitely buy again for next build
reviews.author: dj

reviews.title: High quality
reviews.comment: There are high quality as are any lian li products. Packaged extremely well and are exactly as described. The lighting effects are awesome and are plug and play. Easily controllable with lian lis software and the colors are bright and vivid! Fans blow nice and strong. You can’t beat the value for the money you pay.
reviews.author: Johnathon H.

reviews.title: Look AWESOME and Perform Well!
reviews.comment: I absolutely love these fans! I was on the market for some high-quality fans that would keep my computer cool under intense gaming/work sessions. I wanted something that was both practical, but also looked really cool, and I came across this! What I can say is that it looks absolutely incredible in my build. My GPU is uniquely designed, in that it has a lot of sharp edges and geometric protrusions from it. The Lian-Li fans pair very nicely with it. In terms of performance, they're very quiet, which is perfect if you're coming from a gaming laptop that sounds like an airplane's engine whenever you try to do anything remotely interesting on it. It provides plenty of airflow to my computer's internals. It is on the pricier side, and there are definitely a lot more fans out there that you can buy that will provide plenty of airflow, but because I was looking for aesthetics, these matched it perfectly. I would highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Saul L. Lucas
